NAMES = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'


def rand_name(rng, used):
    while True:
        name = ''.join(rng.choice(NAMES) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 6)))
        if name not in used:
            used.add(name)
            return name


def gen_document(rng):
    used = set()
    doc = {'seed': ''.join(rng.choice(NAMES) for _ in range(rng.randrange(0, 5))),
           'definitions': [], 'timeout_ms': rng.randrange(1, 30),
           'cases': [], 'events': [], 'channels': []}
    cases = []
    for _ in range(rng.randrange(0, 4)):
        name = rand_name(rng, used)
        frames = []
        for _ in range(rng.randrange(0, 6)):
            kind = rng.choice(['headers', 'data', 'datagram', 'sleep'])
            if kind == 'headers':
                if rng.random() < 0.5:
                    frame = {'Type': 'headers',
                             'headers_kv': {rand_name(rng, set()):
                                            rng.choice(['a', 'b', 'v', 'xxx'])}}
                else:
                    frame = {'Type': 'headers',
                             'data_to_transfered': [
                                 [rng.choice([':method', 'a', 'host']),
                                  rng.choice(['GET', 'POST', '/x'])]
                                 for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 4))]}
                if rng.random() < 0.4:
                    frame['End_Stream'] = rng.random() < 0.6
            elif kind == 'sleep':
                frame = {'Type': 'sleep', 'Time_to_Stop': rng.randrange(0, 12)}
            else:
                frame = {'Type': kind,
                         'data_to_transfered': rng.choice(['', 'abc', 'xyzxyzxyz'])}
                if rng.random() < 0.4:
                    frame['End_Stream'] = rng.random() < 0.6
            frames.append(frame)
        cases.append({'name': name, 'frames': frames,
                      'expect': {'method': rng.choice(['GET', 'POST']),
                                 'target': rng.choice(['/a', '/bb']),
                                 'host': rng.choice(['h.example', 'other'])}})
    doc['cases'] = cases
    names = [case['name'] for case in cases]
    for _ in range(rng.randrange(0, 7)):
        kind = rng.choice(['headers', 'data', 'close'])
        if kind == 'close':
            doc['events'].append({'at': rng.randrange(0, 40), 'kind': 'close'})
        elif kind == 'headers':
            doc['events'].append({'at': rng.randrange(0, 40), 'kind': 'headers',
                                  'stream': rng.randrange(0, 16),
                                  'fields': [[rng.choice([':status', 'x']),
                                              rng.choice(['200', 'zz'])]
                                             for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 3))],
                                  'end': rng.random() < 0.6})
        else:
            doc['events'].append({'at': rng.randrange(0, 40), 'kind': 'data',
                                  'stream': rng.randrange(0, 16),
                                  'data': rng.choice(['', 'p', 'qq']),
                                  'end': rng.random() < 0.6})
    for _ in range(rng.randrange(0, 3)):
        parts = []
        for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 5)):
            owner = rng.choice(names + [None]) if names else None
            parts.append({'case': owner, 'data': gen_http(rng)})
        doc['channels'].append({'name': rand_name(rng, set()), 'parts': parts})
    return doc


def gen_http(rng):
    """Random HTTP/1.1-ish capture bytes as an ASCII template string."""
    out = b''
    for _ in range(rng.randrange(0, 4)):
        style = rng.randrange(0, 8)
        method = rng.choice([b'GET', b'POST', b'PUT'])
        target = rng.choice([b'/', b'/a', b'/x?q=1'])
        if style == 0:
            host = rng.choice([b'h.example', b'other', b'EXAMPLE'])
            out += method + b' ' + target + b' HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: ' + host + b'\\r\\n\\r\\n'
        elif style == 1:
            out += (method + b' ' + target + b' HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h.example\\r\\n'
                    b'Content-Length: 3\\r\\n\\r\\nabc')
        elif style == 2:
            out += (method + b' ' + target + b' HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h.example\\r\\n'
                    b'Transfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n2\\r\\nab\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n')
        elif style == 3:
            out += (method + b' ' + target + b' HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h.example\\r\\n'
                    b'Transfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n3;ext\\r\\nxyz\\r\\n0\\r\\nX: 1\\r\\n\\r\\n')
        elif style == 4:
            out += (method + b' ' + target + b' HTTP/1.1\\r\\nhost: h.example\\r\\n'
                    b'Content-Length: 0\\r\\n\\r\\n')
        elif style == 5:
            out += rng.choice([
                b'junk\\r\\n', b'GET /\\r\\n', b'GET / HTTP/1.0\\r\\n\\r\\n',
                b'GET  / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n\\r\\n',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\nContent-Length: 5, 5\\r\\n\\r\\nab',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: Chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n1\\r\\na\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\nContent-Length: 2\\r\\nContent-Length: 2\\r\\n\\r\\nab',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\nHost: y\\r\\n\\r\\n',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nNoColon\\r\\n\\r\\n',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n: empty\\r\\n\\r\\n',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\t y \\r\\n\\r\\n',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked, gzip\\r\\n\\r\\n',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\nContent-Length: 2\\r\\n\\r\\n',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: gzip\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\nContent-Length: \\r\\n\\r\\n',
                b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\nContent-Length: 1,2\\r\\n\\r\\n',
            ])
        elif style == 6:
            out += (method + b' ' + target + b' HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h.example\\r\\n'
                    + b'X: 1\\r\\n' * rng.randrange(0, 3) + b'\\r\\n')
        else:
            out += rng.choice([b'', b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n', b'x', b'\\r\\n',
                               b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost:\\r\\n\\r\\n'])
    if rng.random() < 0.25:
        out += rng.choice([b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: p\\r\\n',
                           b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nContent-Length: 4\\r\\n\\r\\nab',
                           b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: p\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n2\\r\\nab\\r\\n'])
    return out.decode('ascii')
'''
